card.name: Pogonishte
card.tagline: Greece — folk dance from Pogon in southern Albania
card.profile: Pogonishte is a folk dance from Pogon in southern Albania. It is related to the Greek dance Pogonisios (Greek: Πωγωνίσιος) or Sta Dyo (Greek: Στα Δύο). The time signature is in 24, and it is danced in an open circle; dancers bounce twice gently on every count.
card.insight: Pogonishte is a folk dance from Pogon in southern Albania.

steps.description: Opens right, crosses left behind, and crosses left in front twice

lessons.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down the dance structure systematically by musical parts and explains the footwork step by step. He demonstrates movements from the front and then guides through the counts while dancing.
lessons.distinctive_method: Structuring the entire lesson around musical parts (A, B, C) matching a 7/8 rhythm.
what_works: Dividing the song and dance into clear structural parts A, B, and C
what_hinders: Camera angle is overhead and distant, making precise foot placement harder to see clearly
